parent: Exact frozen f696 A_0 allocation plus b472 action/risk/recovery; SOXX is final benchmark, 0bp Tiered own-state account is attribution baseline
mechanism: A single semiconductor heavyweight pulling away from or lagging SOXX can indicate narrow versus broad sector leadership, distinct from XSD/SMH ETF-leadership substitution. NVDA price alone is not its SOXX contribution: no historical weight is inferred.

fixed_source_bridge.old: Use pinned Qlib NVDA $close on all Stage1 signal dates through 2026-07-02 inclusive
fixed_source_bridge.tail: For 2026-07-03 through 2026-10-07, use the final complete regular-session NVDA K_5M AuType.NONE close from the verified NAS peer source, on the same Qlib US session calendar
fixed_source_bridge.seam: The last 13 common Qlib sessions 2026-06-15 through 2026-07-02 must have raw peer/Qlib close absolute difference <=0.0001 and return difference <=0.000001; no fitted rescaling factor
fixed_source_bridge.split: Reject any split_ratio corporate action from 2026-07-03 through 2026-10-07; cash dividends are disclosed but this source uses price-only close for both arms
fixed_source_bridge.factor: log(NVDA close_t / NVDA close_{t-20}) - log(SOXX close_t / SOXX close_{t-20}); completed signal-day t only, available before next trade-day 09:29 ET

if_pass: Only then freeze one SOXL-minus-SOXX H5 matched information screen with original39 and SOXX-only trend controls and a fixed sign; no own-state 0bp account until source timing and information gate are both qualified.
limits: Existing Yahoo-based historical Qlib prices and retrospective Futu peer bytes do not prove every original first-public vintage. A source/novelty pass remains conditional development evidence, not a tradable or promoted feature.
